info.description: A marketing content studio designed for Azure OpenAI structured generation, streaming, safety checks, and per-request cost tracking.
info.what1: Turns a marketing brief into three persona-led content variations.
info.what2: Displays preview and JSON output with SEO keywords.
info.what3: Tracks token usage and estimated cost per request.
info.step1: Write a detailed brief and identify the target audience.
info.step2: Choose a persona, format, and generation settings.
info.step3: Generate, compare, copy, or export the variations.
